intro.text: A powerful ancient being who Connected with the singers across Roshar and was imprisoned during the False Desolation.
One of the Unmade, who Connected with the singers across Roshar and was imprisoned during the False Desolation.
One of the Unmade, imprisoned for some two thousand years after the False Desolation until her release during the True Desolation.

items.text: Mishram sought Honor's promise to make peace with her if Odium could no longer prevent it. Honor agreed, but subsequently made a conflicting agreement with Odium.
She believed Odium prolonged the wars for his own purposes and that the singers deserved a different god.
Mishram accepted the departure of the singers who rejected her war rather than forcing them to remain.

Ba-Ado-Mishram Connected with almost every singer on Roshar at once, a feat spanning the whole continent. Her actions began a new war without the Fused, which scholars later called the False Desolation, though many deny it ever happened.

The singers fought with great zeal, and the Radiants could not work out how she Connected with them. The fighting was fierce, and the singers pressed hard toward Feverstone Keep for reasons the Radiants never understood.
A strike team that included the Heralds Nale and Kalak finally captured and imprisoned her.

Her binding tore Connection and Identity from the singers, leaving them and their descendants unable to act on their own. Humans used these singers as slaves for two thousand years, until the Everstorm healed them, and the singers' fury at this fuelled the True Desolation.
In his journal, Kalak urged that Ba-Ado-Mishram be found and freed. Shallan learned the Ghostbloods were hunting for the gemstone that held her, and vowed to find it before them.
Desperate to escape despite her hatred of humans, Mishram guided Shallan, Renarin and Rlain toward her prison.
Ba-Ado-Mishram was finally freed by Renarin and Rlain in 1175. Her release ended a discordant note that had sounded through Roshar since her binding, and spren began to recover from being deadeyes.

appearance.text: She can appear as a singer with white, red and black skin, changing from smaller than average to enormous, or as a dark cloud moving on limbs.

personality.text: The Unmade Sja-anat considers her crafty and conniving, while Ulim dismisses her as a foolish oversized spren.

items.text: Before becoming the Granter of Forms, Mishram healed wounded singers on battlefields.
Absorbing the Well of Control Connected her to Roshar, its people and its spren, and protected her from Odium's direct touch.
Even while imprisoned, she could project her face and voice into Shadesmar and influence Spiritual Realm visions.
Once freed, she could bring people from the Spiritual Realm into Shadesmar.
